_comment: Where this repo's host (the Claude Code plugin) keeps its rendered prompts, and what it renders them with. plugin_only lists the agents that are HOST ADAPTERS with no host-neutral form, so they stay hand-written in agents/ and the drift check ignores them: nix-builder drives the nix backend, and ops-runner exists only because ctxctl blocks Bash on Claude Code's main thread (a container's driver runs those scripts itself). The core reads this instead of assuming a layout; see UPDATE_ROADMAP.md §3 and tests/test_isolation.py.
